cases.description: Microsoft's documented example: the inverse of the cumulative normal, which round-trips NORM.DIST
cases.expected_note: Excel documents this example's result as 42.000002. The probability 0.908789 is the rounded NORM.DIST(42,40,1.5,TRUE) value, so the inverse returns 42.00000201; rounding to 4 dp gives 42

cases.description: The median of a standard normal is zero
cases.expected_note: Phi(0) = 0.5, so the inverse of 0.5 with mean 0 is exactly the mean, 0

cases.description: The 50th percentile of any normal distribution is its mean
cases.expected_note: Symmetry puts the median at the mean regardless of the standard deviation

cases.description: Probability 0 lies on the open-interval boundary of the domain
cases.expected_note: Excel documents #NUM! if probability <= 0 or probability >= 1 (the normal quantile is unbounded at the endpoints)

cases.description: A negative standard deviation is outside the domain
